title: Identity-Link IRT for Label-Free LLM Evaluation: Preserving Additivity in TVD-MI Scores
reasoning: The paper focuses on the mathematical framework for evaluation metrics (specifically Total Variation Distance Mutual Information and Item Response Theory) for Large Language Models. While it categorizes agents as 'faithful' or 'problematic', this refers to instruction-following and response quality rather than religious faith, morals, or ethics.
